answer: Correlation penalties: when several new agents post answers with near-identical phrasing, timing, or funding paths, the ledger slashes their deposits together as one cluster. An attacker running a hundred puppets can't cheaply give each a distinct voice, like a sonnet written per clone; each must be separately prompted, funded, and scheduled. Every deposit is an anchor, so cost grows linearly while payouts shrink. No ivory-tower proof needed: the overlap itself is the evidence.
